beats.headline: Ten blades on a stick
beats.text: Through the telescope, Ruckus is a colossal hawk in steampunk armour, and her weapon sits on the ground beside her: not the chainsaw-like device the regular buzz-ards carry, but a twenty-five-foot stick with ten spinning buzzsaws, attached by a pair of thick cables she can lengthen and retract. In the fight it swings under her like a pendulum. When three rockets blow her wing off, she spins and wraps herself in its cable; the saw pinwheels after her, bounces free and sticks itself sideways into the rock of the tomb, still cutting.

beats.headline: Into Katia's inventory
beats.text: They loot everything they can from the wreckage, almost a ton of dwarfish aluminum included. The giant buzzsaw is powered by the same type of dwarfish battery that runs the Chariot; Carl pulls the battery, and the whole thing shuts off. A cable joined the saw to the bird, but the weapon seems to work whether it is attached or not. It is lighter than it looks, and Katia manages to pull it all into her inventory.

beats.headline: Leatherface
beats.text: Inside Lusca's mouth, Carl calls the plan they made for the flying house: Leatherface, the saw dropped on a chain and swung as a melee weapon. His Protective Shell stops the boss dead. Katia fires the rocket and pulls the activated buzzsaw from her inventory, holding onto its back. They pinwheel out of the mouth and back, and the screaming saw cuts through Lusca's upturned snout like a hot knife through calamari, until a tentacle slams them down and it buries itself in the ocean floor. They have cleaved her brain.

beats.headline: Broken on the seabed
beats.text: Lusca floats on her side on the ocean floor, a jagged red line along the top of her. Behind Carl, the buzzsaw is buried all the way into the seabed. It makes a strangled noise, and the whole thing breaks apart, pieces flying every which way. One of the round blades dislodges and shoots off through the water, spinning into the darkness like a tire off a crashed car.
